text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Grand Masters concluded, the 
voices of Umamusume, Trainers, and the 
Three Goddesses could still be heard 
echoing in the simulator today—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Three Goddesses, revered as the 
ancestors of Umamusume, support the 
Umamusume and Trainers of today through 
the shared history of those who came 
before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hoping that the path they walked together 
with <chrname> would be remembered and passed down 
through generations, they cheered her on 
from the bottom of their heart to run with 
everything she had.
